verdict.rationale: Galileo's site says datasets can be built from live production data alongside synthetic and development data (galileo-docs-11), and its logging captures every production session, trace and span (galileo-docs-6). Experiments run apps, prompts or models against well-defined inputs and chosen metrics (galileo-docs-2, galileo-docs-3), and datasets and experiments can also be managed via MCP (galileo-docs-4, galileo-docs-32). Missing for 10: step-by-step docs on turning a logged trace into a dataset row (the production-to-dataset claim is marketing copy only), explicit docs on running experiments against those curated datasets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
